create_MMEncoderAttention: create a multimodal encoder attention layer with specified num_heads, head_size, and optional num_kv_heads
compute_max_seqlen: compute the maximum sequence length from cu_seqlens for a given attention backend
recompute_cu_seqlens: recompute cu_seqlens tensors scaled by hidden_size and tp_size for the FlashInfer backend
forward_MMEncoderAttention: run forward pass of MMEncoderAttention with query, key, value tensors and optional cu_seqlens
bucket_flashinfer_max_seqlen: bucket a real max sequence length to the nearest FlashInfer max sequence length bucket
